title: Sets of Ramsey-limit points and IP-limit points
summary: Let $X$ be an uncountable Polish space and let $\mathcal{H}$ be the Hindman ideal, that is, the family of all $S\subseteq ω$ which are not $IP$-sets. For each sequence $x=(x_n)_{n \in ω}$ taking values in $X$, let $Λ_{x}(FS)$ be the set of $IP$-limit points of $x$. Also, let $Λ_{x}(\mathcal{H})$ be the set of $\mathcal{H}$-limit points of $x$, that is, the set of ordinary limits of subsequences $(x_n)_{n \in S}$ with $S\notin \mathcal{H}$.
